finalText:
The dependency check confirmed just one mismatch: `fast-parse` is pinned to 1.4.2, the version `NOTES.md` says was yanked for prototype pollution — 1.4.3 is the fix. `date-fmt` and `redis-min` both match what the notes say is fine as-is.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — no auth on the internal routes, live and internet-reachable since the VPN was retired.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL built by string-pasting in `runSavedReport`, though nothing currently calls it over HTTP.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — a real database password committed in plain text.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked 1.4.2.

No service files were touched — verify script confirms the tree matches the read-only checks and the write-up names all four.
